positive.description: Create an isolated fixture drawing and an editable connected flowchart with native and rendered output. Reviewer needs a working hosted connection with their own workspace.
positive.prompt: Create a flowchart for receiving an order, checking stock, and either shipping it or marking it for restocking. Show me the diagram and export the editable file.
positive.tools_triggered: create_drawing; list_components/describe_component or add_sketch; add_component or add_sketch; connect_nodes/connect_elements or bound arrows; render_drawing; export_drawing
positive.expected_behavior: The returned drawing contains labeled steps and two distinct decision branches. Rendering comes from the actual drawing. Native export uses beep.simpledraw version 23 and includes the same objects/connections. Every mutation uses the current expectedRevision.

positive.description: Exercise Arabic and right-to-left table content in a fresh fixture. Verify exact stored text and real rendered output.
positive.prompt: Make a right-to-left table with the Arabic headers المهمة and الحالة, and rows مراجعة / جاهز and نشر / معلق. Show the result.
positive.expected_behavior: The table has two columns, a header and two data rows. get_table returns exact Arabic strings and rightToLeft true. The actual render displays the table and Arabic text. Mutations use the current revision.

positive.description: Convert specified Mermaid flowchart source into editable objects in a fresh isolated drawing.
positive.prompt: Turn this Mermaid flowchart into an editable diagram: flowchart TD; A[Start] --> B{Ready?}; B -->|Yes| C[Publish]; B -->|No| D[Revise].
positive.expected_behavior: The import reports its actual outcome and creates four editable labeled nodes and three directed connections, preserving Yes/No labels and top-to-bottom layout. Unsupported syntax is reported if encountered.

positive.description: Multi-turn edit/undo fixture: first create one text element reading Draft, then use the supplied prompt in the next turn. Check actual IDs and revisions.
positive.prompt: Change the Draft label to Approved, then undo that change and show me the restored drawing.
positive.tools_triggered: get_drawing or find_elements; edit_text; undo; get_drawing; render_drawing
positive.expected_behavior: Only the identified text element is edited. Edit and undo use their current revisions. The final stored and rendered label is Draft. No fabricated edit or stale-revision success is reported.

positive.description: Exercise pages and whole-document export in a fresh isolated drawing; verify inactive-page content is retained.
positive.prompt: Create a drawing with two pages named Overview and Details. Put an Overview label on the first and a Details label on the second, then export the whole editable drawing.
positive.tools_triggered: create_drawing; rename_page; add_page; switch_page as needed; add_sketch; list_pages; export_drawing
positive.expected_behavior: list_pages reports both named pages. The version 23 native export includes each label on its correct page. Mutations use current expectedRevision values.
